proposal.chemistry_notes: SnAr reaction of 4-fluoronitrobenzene with piperazine in DMF at 120 C. Batch time 6 h. Flow intensification target: 3x reduction -> 2 h residence time. No photochemistry. High temperature requires BPR. DMF bp 153 C, so BPR > 1 bar recommended to ensure liquid phase and safety margin.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Chemistry Plan mandates 3x reduction from batch 6h. 6h / 3 = 2h = 120 min. No analogies provided, so using intensification mandate directly.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (120 C) to ensure conversion. SnAr kinetics are temperature dependent.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: DMF bp is 153 C. Operating at 120 C is below bp, but BPR of 5 bar is set to ensure single-phase liquid flow, prevent bumping, and provide safety margin for high-viscosity DMF at elevated T.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA selected for thermal stability at 120 C and chemical resistance to DMF. FEP also acceptable but PFA has higher temp rating.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Matches batch concentration (0.3 M) to maintain similar kinetics and solubility profiles.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Calculated from V = t * Q = 120 min * 0.5 mL/min = 60 mL. Standard coil length for 1.0 mm ID PFA is approx 76 m for 60 mL.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Selected 0.5 mL/min as a standard low-flow rate for analytical/prep scale to allow for 60 mL reactor volume without excessive pressure drop.

batch_record.reaction_description: 4-Fluoronitrobenzene (1.00 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and piperazine (1.20 mmol, 1.2 equiv) were dissolved in DMF to give a substrate concentration of 0.30 M. The mixture was heated at 120 C under air for 6 h. Standard aqueous workup and purification gave the arylated piperazine product in 81% isolated yield.
